findings.where: h2 section heads vs h3 card titles
findings.evidence: Programmatic outline is correct (h1 > h2 > h3) but the h2s render smaller (18px vs 18.72px) and lighter (#6b7280 vs #111827) than their h3s. A sighted low-vision reader using magnification sees the card titles as the section heads.
findings.after: h2 { font-size: 1.75rem; color: #111827 } so visual and programmatic levels agree.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (advisory: visual structure should match the coded structure) and 2.4.6 Headings and Labels.

findings.evidence: dom-1440.json landmarks: main 0, header 0. All content sits directly in body; with three sections and no landmark there is no 'skip to content' target. (Sweep reported missing main; added here: the h2 sections are plain div.section with no region roles either.)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships; 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks.

strengths: Reflows cleanly at 375: single column, no clipping, no horizontal scroll (tile 375-00).
Coloured side and bottom rules are decorative only; no meaning is carried by colour alone, and the 'New' badge has text.
not_investigated: disputed: focus_ring 'Tab reached no focusable element' is not a defect here; the page has no links, buttons or inputs, so there is nothing to focus
Verified sweep text_floor hits (14px card body) are real on tile 1440-00; dark-card body #9ca3af on #1f2937 checked by eye and the sweep did not flag it
